question: T Balasaraswati, who received the Sangeet Natak Akademi and Padma Vibhushan award, was a _________ dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **T Balasaraswati** was a renowned Indian classical dancer, famous for her mastery of the **Bharatanatyam** dance form.
 
• She is credited with popularizing **Bharatanatyam**, which originated in the temples of Tamil Nadu, as an art form on a global platform.
 
• Balasaraswati was a recipient of prestigious awards such as the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** in 1955 and the **Padma Vibhushan** in 1977 for her outstanding contribution to Indian classical dance.
